findings.title: Prototype Pollution via recursive object merge
findings.description: While `defaults` attempts to block some keys, the `setPath` and `pushPath` utility functions perform property assignment without validating that the path segments do not contain '__proto__', 'constructor', or 'prototype'.
steps_to_exploit: Attacker provides a malicious object containing `__proto__` properties in `addPath` or `loadPath` configurations.
The system merges these objects into internal state or processing structures.
Subsequent operations allow the attacker to overwrite Object prototype properties, influencing application logic.
findings.impact: Denial of service or privilege escalation by altering object behavior globally.
